on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

 ```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

w```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

r```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

t```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

o```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

c```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

E```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

e```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

 ```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

e```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

p```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

k```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

l```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

.```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

a```bash

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

a```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

n```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

h```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

I```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

````bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

````bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

i```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

c```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

f```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

 ```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

t```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

i```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

d```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

.```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

n```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

d```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

s```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

e```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

s```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

o```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

d```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

 ```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

l```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

 ```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

 ```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

a```bash

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.


```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.


```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

e```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

#### Multiple phones and aliases

Every phone becomes its own MCP server (`phone-work-phone` above, with tools
`mcp__phone-work-phone__*`), and can have any number of aliases. Then just say "unlock the work
phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

t```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phone" or "what's on Moto's screen".

```bash
phones.py list                      # phones, aliases, addresses, live status
phones.py alias phone-work-phone "służbowy"
phones.py resolve "work phone"      # -> phone-work-phone
phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

n```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.

phones.py add <new-address> --name phone-work-phone   # the phone's IP changed; keeps the token
phones.py remove phone-work-phone
```

Tokens stay in Claude Code's own config; the alias registry (`~/.config/phone-mcp/phones.json`)
holds only names, aliases and addresses.

r```bash
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills && cp -r skills/android-phone ~/.claude/skills/
# the user saves the phone's token without pasting it into a chat:
read -rs T && (umask 077; printf '%s' "$T" > ~/.phone-mcp-token-work)
~/.claude/skills/android-phone/scripts/phones.py add <phone-ip-or-tailscale-address> \
  --alias "Work phone" --alias Moto --token-file ~/.phone-mcp-token-work
```

A VPS can't reach a phone on home Wi-Fi. Install [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com) on the phone and
on the VPS with the same account, and use the phone's `100.x.y.z` address.
